confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for July 2026, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by district and season. Cocktail and wine_glass are weaker: no direct recall was strong enough, so they were set from the local beer-to-bar and beer-to-restaurant price relationship. FX: 0.6955 is the RBA observation for 2026-10-15 as reported in a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates overview page. I did not open the F11.1 table itself, and I did not use a third-party 16 October figure.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other mid-to-large Chinese tourist cities with West Lake-style attractions and mainland Chinese price levels (for example Suzhou and Nanjing, and lower-priced parts of Shanghai). Accommodation is set against the districts visitors usually stay in, such as near West Lake and the central business district.
